keyTakeaways.title: Why Schools Take 54.8% of Every Tax Check in Town of Morristown
keyTakeaways.detail: Because Town of Morristown is classified as an affluent suburban district under NJ SFRA school aid formulas, State Aid covers roughly 10% of educational spending. Local property taxpayers must fund the remaining ~90%.

keyTakeaways.title: Commercial Ratable Retention vs. PILOT Burdens
keyTakeaways.detail: Commercial ratables represent 43.6% of Town of Morristown's tax base. Protecting business ratables while ensuring that new luxury developments pay their fair share to the school district is the central taxpayer challenge.
